title: pgbot: a Postgres health check that runs on a read-only role and installs nothing
description:
pgbot checks your Postgres database's health without touching it, no agent, no write access, just a read only role and the stats views Postgres already tracks. It scores the database zero to a hundred and flags findings as critical, warning, note, or good. It keeps a local baseline, so it knows what got worse since last time. It also knows the quirks of RDS, Supabase, and Neon.

https://github.com/pgrundev/pgbot
